text:
ravi: Quick idea: expose `X-Tenant-Override` header for controlled routing when SA keys must act on behalf of different tenants. Keeps intent explicit.
megan: Good for infra jobs. Start audit-only, then opt-in per-org for live routing.
li: Security: require `assume_tenants` claim or per-key ACL check. If header used without permission -> 403 + audit.
finance-jo: For billing exports we need `resolved_tenant` and `tenant_override` fields. We'll need a 30-day migration window.
ops-bot: Canary plan queued: audit-only for 2 weeks in staging, then 5% traffic canary for whitelisted orgs.
megan: Telemetry: add `tenant_source` label (claim|header_audit|header_override) and track `override_attempts` and `override_rejects`.
li: Implementation tasks: gateway parse header -> auth validation -> emit audit event -> routing uses resolved tenant when enabled. Keep auth p95 <35ms.
ravi: Action items: @li implement auth + audit, @megan add metrics & dashboard, @finance-jo add billing fields and notify downstream. Conservative rollout.
